color_palette.glass_effect: Liquid Glassmorphism (High blur, mesh gradients, subtle refraction)
color_palette.map_theme: Greyed-out / Desaturated base with neon blue data overlays

map_layer.styling: - CSS Filter: brightness(0.6) invert(1) contrast(3) hue-rotate(200deg) saturate(0.3) - Full-screen background layer
map_layer.overlays: - Drone Path: Semi-transparent neon blue polyline - Issue Markers: Pulsing SVG icons (Potholes, Streetlights, etc.) - Marker Colors: Red (High Severity), Yellow (Medium), Green (Low)

header.title: Your City, Providence
header.styling: Modern bold sans-serif, subtle cyan outer glow, glassmorphism background

live_toggle.function: Open Liquid Glass Side Panel for Live Drone Feed

side_panel.styling: - backdrop-filter: blur(40px) - background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) - border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) - mesh-gradient-overlay: subtle moving cyan/purple blobs
side_panel.content: - Live Camera Feed (Simulated) - Drone Telemetry (Alt, Speed, Battery)

bottom_controls.timeline_slider: - Visibility: Only when Clock Icon is active - Function: Scrub through past 24 hours of drone data

filter_button.styling: Circular glass button with neon border

ui_design_prompt.ux_interactions: - Smooth transitions for side panel entry (slide + fade) - Hover effects on map markers showing ticket snapshots - "Liquid" feel: subtle animations on glass panels to simulate surface tension
